Name: Grace's Birch and Mahogany Furniture Recolor
Author: svnshxne
Description:
✦ The CP version is configurable with the mod config menu; you can choose to have only birch or mahogany furniture recolored (both will be recolored by default)

✦ The CP version is compatible with Vibrant Pastoral Recolor, Rosier Colored Glasses, DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors and Starblue Valley. It might conflict with other CP recolor mods if the other mod recolors the mahogany and/or birch furniture. 

✦ I was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12403]Lynn’s Bedroom for DGA[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12669]Pretty Pink Furniture Recolour[/url]. I recommend that you check out their other mods! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/138007818]Lynn Nexus[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/131496263]Twinkle22[/url]
